control_policy.FAIL_RESULT_STATE: terminate without release, submission, or retry
control_policy.FAIL_STOP: terminate without release, submission, or retry
control_policy.HOLDOUT_LOCKED: if exactly 19 calibrations succeeded and no controller is active, call frozen release_holdout once, then submit_next for wave 53
control_policy.READY_CALIBRATION: if no active joint95 controller, call existing submit_next once
control_policy.READY_HOLDOUT: if no active joint95 controller, call existing submit_next once
control_policy.TERMINAL_CONTROLLER_WITHOUT_SUCCESS: terminate when the exact expected-wave controller signature is already terminal but its valid PASS result is absent

decision_inputs: successful calibration count only for the frozen 19-unit release boundary
prohibited: submission while any joint95 controller is active
retry after any failed or invalid attempt
score-dependent selection outside the registered rank-19 release
v1 evidence reuse, server pulls, or paper edits
score_policy: The supervisor never reads a score for branching. The existing frozen release_holdout API alone computes registered rank 19.
